integrity: General proof uses exact rank-one parametrization and spectral count; exhaustive finite checks for q=2,4,8,16 only. No independent audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: Only regular nilpotent 3x3 Jordan matrices and finite characteristic-two fields; labeled matrix counts, not similarity-class counts. The 2022 publisher full text could not be inspected and historic priority remains qualified.
title: Affine-plane fibers of diagonalizable square-zero perturbations of a three-dimensional Jordan block
